ambiguity_heatmap.root_cause: Creators struggle to balance 'approachable' with 'authoritative', leading to accidental slang.
ambiguity_heatmap.suggested_guideline_rewrite: Clarify with explicit positive/negative sentence pairs. Add: 'Use active verbs and plain language, but avoid conversational idioms, internet slang, and excessive punctuation.'

ambiguity_heatmap.root_cause: Sales and growth teams conflate SOC-2 certification with 'unhackable' marketing language.
ambiguity_heatmap.suggested_guideline_rewrite: Explicitly mandate Fact Base citation: 'Never state that security is absolute or impenetrable. Always specify the exact compliance certification (e.g., SOC-2 Type II, ISO 27001).'

ambiguity_heatmap.root_cause: Old agency templates still reference 2025 starter pricing sheets.
ambiguity_heatmap.suggested_guideline_rewrite: Issue automated template deprecation notice: 'All collateral citing $19/mo tiers must be updated to $29/mo Growth pricing. Remove legacy PDF decks from shared drives.'

ambiguity_heatmap.rule_title: WCAG 2.1 Contrast Thresholds on Social Assets
ambiguity_heatmap.root_cause: Designers use muted secondary grays (#A0AEC0) on white cards for subtle aesthetics.
ambiguity_heatmap.suggested_guideline_rewrite: Provide approved dark token: 'Muted text on white backgrounds must use #4A5568 or darker to guarantee a minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio under WCAG AA.'
